name: ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor is the free website foundation of the Vendix ecosystem. It combines essential Elementor widgets with centralized business information and practical tools for search visibility, structured data, icons and media management.

One focused workspace replaces a separate plugin for every small need.

✨ Everything included in Free

  • Guided Setup with one-click undo.
  • 33 Elementor widgets, with news widgets and the ARN Form.
  • Company Information with shortcodes and Dynamic Tags.
  • Design System: brand colors and body and heading fonts for ARN widgets or the whole site; Google fonts are downloaded once and served from the site.
  • ARN Smart Icon Manager with 3,800 font-free icons.
  • SEO & Visibility Engine, Header & Footer Builder and review-first AI Media Intelligence.
  • Smart Features and WooCommerce Tools.
  • Responsive, RTL/LTR and accessibility-aware output; optional systems load only when required.
  • No license key and no private updater: updates come through the WordPress repository.

🧭 Guided Setup

ARN Utilities → Setup opens once after the first activation (the Vendix theme’s welcome page leads to it too) and sets up a site in about five minutes.

  • Pick Business, News & Magazine or Online Store to turn on the features that kind of site needs.
  • Choose one of six palettes and four font pairs (or keep your colors), enter company details once, and optionally add sample pages, a Main menu and a simple header and footer. WooCommerce is installed and activated only when you click.
  • Undo setup restores your earlier settings and moves the pages and layouts it made to the Trash; posts, products, orders, existing pages and menus are never touched.

🧩 33 Elementor widgets

Widgets sit in the ARN Smart Site Utilities Elementor category and start with sample text and drawings, so a page looks finished before you edit it.

  • Headings and text: Advanced Heading, Icon Heading, List Block, Smart Text Editor.
  • Hero and calls to action: Hero Slider, Button, CTA, Counter, Feature Block, Process / Timeline, Pricing Table.
  • People and trust: Testimonials, Team Members, Logo Carousel, Rating Badge.
  • Company and contact: Company Information, Contact Cards, Get in Touch, Business Hours, ARN Form.
  • Site parts: Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools, Site Logo, Breadcrumbs, Announcement Bar.
  • Content and media: Post / Content Grid, FAQ, Responsive Image, Release Notes.
  • News widgets (Smart Features → News Widgets, off by default): Section Header, News Blocks, News Ticker.

Site Utilities runs on other themes too; it is developed and tested with the Vendix theme, where it fits best. The FAQ describes each widget.

🧱 Header & Footer Builder

Build site headers and footers under ARN Utilities → Header & Footer without a page builder template.

  • Rows and columns with logo, menu, mobile menu, search, button, text, contact, social, language, account, cart, wishlist, copyright, image, HTML, spacer and divider elements.
  • Display rules (whole site, front page, search, 404, single content or archives) with exclusions; sticky and transparent headers (kept below a sticky ARN Announcement Bar), a mobile panel and live preview.
  • A page, post or product can pick its own header and footer (by the rules, none or a published layout) on its edit screen or in Elementor’s page settings.
  • Works with classic and block themes, Elementor Full Width and Canvas templates, and the Vendix theme’s header and footer places.
  • Keyboard and screen reader friendly: the mobile panel and search layer keep the focus inside, and Escape closes a sub-menu.

🏢 Company Information, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags

Enter website, company, contact, legal and social data once under ARN Utilities → Company Data and reuse it in Site Utilities widgets, in any content through shortcodes, and in native Elementor widgets through Dynamic Tags.

Policies, agreements, contact pages and footers repeat the same details; with shortcodes, an address, phone number or legal detail is updated in one field instead of on dozens of pages:

[arnsmesu_company_legal_name], registered under [arnsmesu_company_trade_registry], operates from [arnsmesu_company_address]. Contact: [arnsmesu_company_phone].

The FAQ lists every field, shortcode and Dynamic Tag.

🎨 ARN Smart Icon Manager

  • 3,800 unique, font-free SVG-mask icons in two sets, Default Icons (1,181) and Interface Essentials (2,994), that take the Elementor color and scale cleanly at any size.
  • Category and icon search, a personal My Icons selection and whole categories; large styles load by pack, not the whole library on every page.
  • Disabling a category never breaks icons already saved in Elementor content. Elementor’s own and Font Awesome libraries remain available.

📈 SEO & Visibility Engine

Off until an administrator enables it, the Visibility Engine works as a complete visibility layer, or only as an analyzer when another supported SEO plugin controls public metadata.

  • SEO title, meta description, canonical URL, robots, Open Graph and X cards, with a live social sharing preview.
  • Analysis of the rendered content (Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, shortcodes) with a page language check, a readiness score and recommendations.
  • Connected JSON-LD Schema and a controlled XML sitemap.

These tools improve content structure and machine understanding; they do not promise rankings or AI citations.

🤖 AI Media Intelligence

AI Media is optional, disabled by default and preview-first, so an administrator stays in control.

  • Filename, title, slug and alt-text suggestions, previewed before applying, one by one or in batches.
  • Filename changes keep WordPress metadata and content references in sync; every change is recorded and can be restored.
  • Optional alt text for newly uploaded images.

AI runs through Settings → ARN Free AI, shared by ARN Free plugins: WordPress AI (Settings → Connectors on WordPress 7.0+, no API key stored), or your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot AI), xAI Grok, Mistral or an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint, with the model you choose, prices, usage and monthly limits. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.

If ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI, AI Media leaves suggestions and automatic alt text to it and links to it.

🧰 Smart Features

Each is switched on or off under ARN Utilities → Smart Features:

  • Admin Notes on the dashboard, personal or shared.
  • Draft Preview Links that expire after 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days and can be revoked.
  • Search & Replace for the database with preview, undo of the last 5 runs, old domain scan and cache purge.
  • Disable Comments site-wide, without ever deleting existing comments.
  • Site Banner, News Widgets and the Quick Menu of admin shortcuts to filtered lists.
  • Push Notifications for new posts with a subscribe box, sent from your own site (Web Push, no third-party service).

🛒 WooCommerce Tools

With WooCommerce active; each tool is off by default.

  • Store Type: Physical, Virtual, Digital or Mixed; the product editor adjusts, existing products are never changed automatically.
  • Product Identifiers & Cost: MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP, Manufacturer, Supplier and three cost fields, with live, tax-aware profit margins; costs are never shown to customers.
  • Quantity Discounts: tiers such as “5 or more: 10% off”, applied in the classic and block cart.
  • Order Limits: minimum and maximum quantities and amounts per product, category or cart.
  • Customer Order Changes: before shipping, logged-in customers change the delivery address or cancel from My Account, within your rules.
  • Product Questions: customers ask on the product page; answers show in a “Questions” tab and e-mail the asker.
  • Shipping on the Product Page: shipping methods and costs for the customer’s address, under “Add to cart”.
  • Product Interest: 30-day views and adds to cart per product, without cookies or personal data.
  • Pricing Zones: prices per group of countries by a percentage with rounding; the zone comes from the visitor’s choice ([arnsmesu_zone_selector]), their address or WooCommerce geolocation, and payment stays in the store currency.

⚙️ Settings and data lifecycle

  • Optional modules stay inactive until enabled; deactivation never deletes settings, content or company information.
  • Data is removed only with the uninstall option on and the plugin deleted; Vendix Pro data and Elementor templates stay. Multisite-aware.

⭐ Upgrade to ARN Smart Vendix Pro

ARN Smart Vendix, the professional Elementor framework for larger websites, includes all of Free and adds:

  • More widgets (hero designs, sliders, carousels, tabs, tickers, countdowns, pricing and comparison tables, modals, hotspots, before/after images) and more layouts for the Free widgets.
  • The full newspaper set, the full Design System with the Elementor Kit, and advanced and custom setup levels.
  • Form Guard, per content-type Disable Comments, a Store Type scan-and-convert tool and other site tools.
  • Dynamic Content (your own content types and fields) with listings, showcase cards and a demo gallery; quote and newsletter forms; push for breaking news, topics, store updates and campaigns, also via OneSignal or Firebase.
  • Store modules such as discount rules, quotes, delivery slots, returns and exchanges and a profit report.
  • AEO / GEO / AIO analysis, E-E-A-T evidence checks and the Site Report.
  • License management, private Pro updates and priority support.

Site Utilities stays independently installable and usable without a Vendix Pro license.

🔗 Other ARN Smart Products

Focused ARN Smart products, usable alone or together:

  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer / ARN Smart WebPix — local image optimization in Free; advanced discovery, coverage, queues, delivery, and diagnostics in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Content Toolkit / ARN Smart Clonex — controlled draft preparation in Free; structured duplication, datasets, bulk production, and builder-aware workflows in Pro.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager / ARN Smart Linkix — short links, redirects, QR codes, and local analytics in Free; custom permalinks, Smart App Links, branded QR, analytics, and maintenance in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Visitor Intent / ARN Smart Visioix — visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics, and contact actions in Free; connected visitor and website intelligence in Pro.

Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External services

AI Media (ARN Free AI). The plugin contacts no ARN server. AI stays off until an administrator chooses a provider and enters their own API key (stored encrypted in the database) under Settings > ARN Free AI; requests then go to that provider only.

Requests are sent only while Media Intelligence is enabled: when an administrator clicks AI Preview or Generate Selected Previews, or when automatic alt text (off by default) runs for a new upload. Sent data: the image (a copy of at most 4 MB, preferably a smaller WordPress size; SVG files are not sent) and its context: site name and tagline, file name and type, title, slug, current alt text, caption, a short description, the parent post title, the titles and short excerpts of up to three posts that use the file, and the site language. “Test connection” (a fixed test prompt, no site content) and “Load models” (the provider’s model list) also contact the chosen provider when clicked. Nothing is sent while AI is not set up or while ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: the address the administrator enters, under that service’s own terms.

With WordPress AI, requests go through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

ARN Free AI keeps its settings in the arn_free_ai_settings option and daily usage totals (no prompts, answers or keys) in the {prefix}arn_free_ai_usage table.

Design System Google fonts. Only when an administrator picks a Google font for body or headings under ARN Utilities > Design System and saves, the server downloads it once: the stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and its WOFF2 files from fonts.gstatic.com (Latin, Latin Extended and Arabic, the Design System’s weights). Only the font family and weights are sent, no visitor or site data. The files are served from wp-content/uploads/arnsmesu-fonts, so visitors’ browsers never connect to Google. The font list comes from Elementor.

  • Google Fonts: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy

Search & Replace. Only when an administrator uses it: “Find old addresses” sends one HTTP HEAD request for a sample file to each of at most 5 earlier site addresses found in the database, to see whether they still answer (no site data is sent); after a run or an undo, the plugin requests the site’s own home page once to detect a server or CDN page cache.

Guided Setup. Only when an administrator clicks “Install & activate” on the Plugins step of an online-store setup: WordPress’s own plugin installer downloads WooCommerce from WordPress.org, as under Plugins → Add Plugin. No other setup step uses an external service.

  • WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

Web push notifications. With Push Notifications on (Smart Features), your site itself sends each notification, encrypted, to the push service of the subscribed visitor’s browser, with no account or third-party notification service. The browser, not this plugin, picks the service:

  • Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet, Brave): https://fcm.googleapis.com — Terms: https://firebase.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Mozilla Push Service (Firefox): https://updates.push.services.mozilla.com — Terms: https://www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/services/ — Privacy: https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/firefox/
  • Apple Push Notification service (Safari, iPhone and iPad): https://web.push.apple.com — Privacy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/
  • Microsoft Windows Push Notification Services (older Edge): https://*.notify.windows.com — Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

Requests are sent only when a notification goes out (a post published with “Send to subscribers when published” ticked, or a test), to the address the visitor’s browser gave when subscribing. Each carries the notification (title, text, link, image address) encrypted for that browser only, a time to live, and a signed header with your site’s public key and your site address or contact e-mail. The plugin sends no visitor IP address or other visitor personal data. Nothing is sent while the feature is off.

The Header & Footer Builder, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links, Social Sharing Preview, ARN Form and news reads and corrections use no external service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor.
  2. Make sure Elementor is active.
  3. Follow the guided setup under ARN Utilities → Setup (it opens once after activation), or open ARN Utilities → Company Data and enter the reusable organization details.
  4. Open Elementor and find the widgets under ARN Smart Site Utilities.
  5. Enable AI Media or SEO & Visibility only when the website needs those modules.
sections.faq:
Does the Free version require a license key?

No. Site Utilities has no license gate and no private-update client.

Can the four header widgets be used without a Vendix header template?

Yes. Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools and Site Logo are normal Elementor widgets. They can be placed in theme templates, Elementor templates, page content or any compatible layout.

Why should company information use shortcodes or Dynamic Tags?

They prevent the same legal, contact and organization information from being manually repeated across many pages. One update can refresh every connected location.

Will changing a media filename break its existing use?

The media transaction updates supported WordPress and Elementor references and records the previous state. Administrators can review changes first and restore the original state when necessary.

Does the plugin replace my current SEO plugin automatically?

No. The Visibility Engine is opt-in and checks for another active SEO system before taking ownership of public metadata, Schema or sitemap output.

Are AI features automatic?

No. AI Media is disabled by default, and it is designed around review-first suggestions. When enabled, it uses the AI connection set up under Settings → ARN Free AI: WordPress AI (a provider connected under Settings → Connectors) or a provider you configure with your own API key and model. Automatic alt text for new uploads runs only when you turn it on and AI is set up.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

By default your settings and content are kept. With “Delete all Site Utilities data when the plugin is permanently uninstalled” on (ARN Utilities → Settings), Site Utilities settings, logs, analysis metadata, Header & Footer layouts and admin notes are removed, and so are form entries, push subscribers and keys, product questions, quantity tiers, order limits, read and product interest counts and correction notes, except the data that an installed ARN Smart Vendix uses too; on Multisite each site follows its own choice. The shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of those sites are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them.

Is my product cost or margin data ever shown to customers?

No. Cost, Shipping Cost and Other Costs are internal-only by design — there is no setting that puts them on the frontend or in structured data, unlike the other Product Identifiers fields.

Do push notifications work on iPhone and iPad?

Yes, on iOS and iPadOS 16.4 or later, once the visitor has added the site to the Home Screen and opens it from there; the subscribe box shows these steps to iPhone and iPad visitors. For this the plugin adds a small web app manifest (“Add a web app manifest for iPhone and iPad”, on by default), unless a PWA plugin already prints one.

Does Product Identifiers create a duplicate barcode field?

Not when your WooCommerce version already has a native Global Unique ID field (WooCommerce 8.0+). GTIN reuses that field instead of creating a second one, and simply adds the extra list column, Quick Edit and structured-data support around it.

What does each widget do?

  1. ARN Advanced Heading — Builds layered headings with upper text, main text, highlighted words, lower text, multiple layout presets, decorative lines, responsive alignment, optional CTA and load/scroll highlight animation.
  2. ARN Breadcrumbs — Shows the automatic trail of the page (page hierarchy or the post’s categories) in the Minimal or Rounded Trail layout; the BreadcrumbList schema follows the trail shown.
  3. ARN Business Hours — Displays opening hours in structured rows, supports centralized company hours, open/closed presentation, responsive styling and an optional action button.
  4. ARN Button — Creates flexible CTA buttons with icons, responsive sizing, solid/outline/gradient visual styles, hover motion and optional animated backgrounds.
  5. ARN Company Information — Creates sortable company-data rows with selectable fields, custom labels, automatic links, icons and list, grid or inline layouts.
  6. ARN Contact Cards — Branch and contact cards with phone, email, address, working hours, a directions link and a button, in the Branch Cards or Compact Rows layout.
  7. ARN Counter — Animated or static numbers with prefix, suffix, decimals and a thousands separator, starting when they come into view.
  8. ARN CTA — A call-to-action box with a badge, title, text and one or two buttons on a solid or gradient background.
  9. ARN FAQ — Builds accessible accordion FAQs with multiple-open mode, open/close all control, URL hashes, keyboard navigation, configurable animation and optional FAQ Schema.
  10. ARN Feature Block — Creates service, benefit, process and feature cards with icons or images, numbers, descriptions, links, buttons, multiple layouts, equal heights and responsive columns.
  11. ARN Get in Touch — Displays address, phone, email, WhatsApp, map and social channels using centralized or custom values, with automatic links and detailed responsive styling.
  12. ARN Header Search — Adds a compact website search field or search-icon presentation suitable for Elementor headers and other page areas.
  13. ARN Header Tools — Adds reusable account, wishlist and WooCommerce cart actions with optional cart count. It can be placed in any Elementor layout.
  14. ARN Hero Slider — Full-width slides with desktop and mobile images, title, subtitle, description, up to three buttons, an overlay, autoplay, fade or slide transitions, arrows and dots.
  15. ARN Icon Heading — Combines an icon or image with a title for compact service labels, feature headings and navigation-style content.
  16. ARN List Block — Builds structured icon, image or numbered lists with titles, descriptions, links, bulk entry support, responsive layouts and precise marker alignment.
  17. ARN Logo Carousel — An endless logo strip or a static grid with speed, pause on hover and focus, visible logo count and grayscale styles.
  18. ARN Navigation Menu — Displays a selected WordPress menu or your own list of custom links, with Header and Inner menu types, 10 item styles, active page highlighting, border and line colors and thickness for normal, hover and active states, dropdown support, responsive collapse controls, mobile panel behavior and keyboard-friendly interaction.
  19. ARN Post / Content Grid — The latest posts, pages or other content as Clean Cards or a Horizontal List, with excerpt, topic label, “Read more” text and an empty-state message.
  20. ARN Pricing Table — Plans with price, currency, features, a featured plan badge and a button, in the Clean Split or Featured Plan design.
  21. ARN Process / Timeline — Steps as Horizontal Steps or a Vertical Timeline, with marker content and shape settings and a connecting line.
  22. ARN Responsive Image — Uses separate desktop, tablet and mobile images with alt text, links, lazy/eager loading, fixed or natural visual slots, object fit, alignment, offsets, transforms and responsive visibility.
  23. ARN Site Logo — Displays the centralized company logo, the WordPress custom logo or a custom image with responsive sizing and linking controls.
  24. ARN Smart Text Editor — Adds rich text with an Add Shortcode selector so centralized company and legal values can be inserted directly into long-form content.
  25. ARN Team Members — Team cards with photo, role, short text and email, LinkedIn and profile links, in the Classic Cards or Compact List layout.
  26. ARN Testimonials — Customer quotes in a grid with name, role, photo, company logo, star rating and source link.
  27. ARN Announcement Bar — A bar with text, an icon and a button, in the page or sticky at the top, with its own colors; a closed bar stays closed in the visitor’s browser for the days you choose and comes back when its message changes.
  28. ARN Form — A contact form with your own fields, a notification e-mail, a thank-you message or another address after sending, and built-in spam checks (a hidden field, a minimum time, a rate limit and repeated messages). Entries are kept under ARN Utilities → Forms, with whether the notification was sent.
  29. ARN Rating Badge — A score and a review count in the Inline, Card, Pill or Platforms layout (WordPress.org, G2, Trustpilot, Google, Capterra or your own platform; you upload the logos), with stars filled to the score, numbers in the site’s format and optional AggregateRating structured data.
  30. ARN Release Notes — Versions with number, date, title and labeled items (New, Improved, Fixed, Removed, Security) in the Timeline, Cards or Compact layout, with the newest versions open, a label filter and a link to each version.
  31. ARN Section Header (news widget) — The title bar of a news section in four styles, with a subtitle and a “More” link.
  32. ARN News Blocks (news widget) — The latest posts, or the posts of chosen categories, in three newspaper layouts (lead beside a list, lead on top with a grid below, a grid of equal items), with an optional header and a link at the end.
  33. ARN News Ticker (news widget) — A breaking news band with a label and the latest headlines scrolling in a loop, with a pause button; with reduced motion it shows one headline at a time with arrows.

Which company fields, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags are available?

Fields: site name, company email and site URL; full and short company name, company logo, address, two phone numbers, WhatsApp number, working hours and map URL; legal company name, tax office and tax number, trade registry number, MERSIS or company registry ID and chamber registration number; Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and TikTok.

Common shortcodes

  • [arnsmesu_site_name] — Website name
  • [arnsmesu_site_mail] — Company email
  • [arnsmesu_site_link] — Website URL
  • [arnsmesu_company_name] — Full company name
  • [arnsmesu_company_name_short] — Short company name
  • [arnsmesu_company_logo] — Company logo
  • [arnsmesu_company_address] — Company address
  • [arnsmesu_company_phone] — One or two linked phone numbers
  • [arnsmesu_company_whatsapp] — Linked WhatsApp number
  • [arnsmesu_company_hours] — Working hours
  • [arnsmesu_company_map] — Map link
  • [arnsmesu_company_legal_name] — Registered legal name
  • [arnsmesu_company_tax] — Tax office and tax number
  • [arnsmesu_company_trade_registry] — Trade registry number
  • [arnsmesu_company_mersis] — MERSIS or company registry ID
  • [arnsmesu_company_chamber] — Chamber registration number
  • [arnsmesu_company_social network="linkedin"] — Selected social profile
  • [arnsmesu_current_date] — Current date using the WordPress timezone and date format
  • [arnsmesu_company field="current_year"] — Current year using the WordPress timezone

Flexible shortcodes

  • [arnsmesu_company_value field="company_name" fallback="Company"] returns any supported field with an optional fallback.
  • [arnsmesu_company field="company_address" link="auto" multiline="yes"] controls fallback, linking, label, multiline output and link target.
  • [arnsmesu_company_link type="whatsapp" label="Contact us"] creates phone, email, WhatsApp, map, website or social links.

Elementor Dynamic Tags: Company Value for text controls, Company Dynamic Link for phone, email, WhatsApp, map, website and social URLs, and Company Logo for image and media controls, each with an optional fallback value.

Changing a saved value updates every shortcode, Dynamic Tag and connected Site Utilities widget that uses it.

What does the SEO & Visibility Engine output and check?

Search and social metadata: custom SEO title and meta description per page or post, canonical URL and robots directives, focus phrase, supporting phrases and search-intent planning fields, Open Graph and X/Twitter card metadata, a default social image with per-page overrides, and automatic suppression of duplicate public output when another SEO system is active.

Rendered-content analysis: one resolved visible content source to prevent duplicate counting; word, paragraph and sentence diagnostics; H1 and heading-hierarchy checks; image and missing-alt checks; internal and external link checks; lists, tables and topic detection; a page language check (site language, Polylang or WPML) so phrases are matched in the right writing system; a page-level readiness score with actionable recommendations.

Connected JSON-LD Schema: WebSite; Organization, Corporation or LocalBusiness; WebPage, AboutPage, ContactPage and CollectionPage; Article and BlogPosting; Service and Product; BreadcrumbList; FAQPage through the FAQ widget; connected publisher, image and page relationships.

Controlled XML sitemap: selected post types and taxonomies, optional author archives, specific content IDs excluded and a configurable maximum of URLs per sitemap part. Noindex content, builder templates, password-protected items and unsuitable content are excluded automatically.

How does AI Media work?

  • One AI Media page with General, Media Library and AI Connection tabs.
  • Filter all media, images with missing alt text, generic filenames or items previously changed by Site Utilities.
  • Preview every proposed value and choose which fields are changed for each media item; generate and apply selected items in batches; preview controlled word replacements.
  • Physical filename changes stay synchronized with WordPress metadata and stored content references; every change is recorded as a reversible transaction that restores the original filename, title, slug and alt text.
  • Missing alt text can be prepared for newly uploaded images; decorative images are skipped and low-confidence automatic suggestions go to review.

Until AI is set up under Settings → ARN Free AI, suggestions come from the file name and context without AI and new uploads get no automatic alt text. When the provider chosen for images cannot read images, the suggestion is made from the context only, marked as a guess and never saved automatically. API keys can also be supplied through wp-config.php constants (ARN_FREE_AI_<PROVIDER>_KEY, for example ARN_FREE_AI_OPENAI_KEY). The AI Connection tab shows whether AI is set up and this month’s AI use of the plugin.

What exactly do the Smart Features do?

Admin Notes: a dashboard box for notes with colors, personal or shared visibility, and mark-as-done.

Draft Preview Links: share a draft with people who have no account through a secret link that expires after 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days, and can be revoked. Preview pages are marked “Draft preview”, are not indexed or cached, and do not print the plugin’s SEO or Schema output.

Search & Replace: search and replace text or old addresses in the database, with a preview of the affected rows before anything changes; undo any of the last 5 runs; an old domain scan finds earlier site addresses still stored in the database; supported page caches are purged after a run. Administrators only; on Multisite, Super Admins only.

Disable Comments: one switch stops new comments and pingbacks everywhere on the site. Optionally hide the Comments menu item and the admin bar comment bubble (with a safe redirect if the direct URL is visited) and remove comment widgets from the Dashboard. Existing comments are never deleted, hidden or moderated. Per content-type control is a Vendix Pro feature.

Site Banner: one image banner with alt text and a link (new tab, sponsored or nofollow), placed anywhere with the [arnsmesu_banner] shortcode.

News Widgets: one switch adds ARN Section Header, ARN News Blocks and ARN News Ticker to Elementor. While it is on, the reads of posts are counted too (reads and how many read to the end, in a “Reads (30 days)” column of the posts list; no cookies or personal data; it can be turned off), and editors add time-stamped “Correction” or “Update” notes to a post in its “Corrections and updates” box: the notes show after the post, the newest one becomes the post’s dateModified, and [arnsmesu_corrections] lists the latest notes of all posts. While it is off, no news widget is offered and no news style sheet loads.

Push Notifications: visitors who agree get a browser notification when you publish a post. Your site sends them itself with Web Push: no account or notification service to sign up for. A subscribe box asks in two steps (the browser’s own question comes only after the visitor clicks), with timing and page rules; the post screen has “Send to subscribers when published” with an optional title and text, and the notification goes out one minute after publishing. A test to your own browser, “Subscribe this browser” and the last 10 notifications are in the settings.

Quick Menu: custom admin menu shortcuts to filtered product or post lists, with no code and no limit on the number of links. Filter by post type, post status, taxonomy/term, stock status, product type or a custom query string; group links under one custom parent menu with its own icon and position, or give a link its own top-level menu; set the required capability per link and whether it opens in a new tab. Links are rebuilt from the site’s own address plus allowlisted query parameters every time they render, so nothing breaks if the site moves.

How do Store Type and Product Identifiers work?

Store Type

  • Physical mode removes the Virtual/Downloadable checkboxes from the editor and enforces the setting on every save using WooCommerce’s own CRUD methods.
  • Virtual and Digital modes pre-check the right boxes for brand-new products only — existing products are never changed automatically.
  • Independently restrict which product types (Simple, Variable, Grouped, External/Affiliate) can be selected, regardless of store mode.
  • Optional toggle to stop saving variation price-cache meta that WooCommerce regenerates on demand, reducing database bloat on large catalogs.
  • A one-click scan-and-convert tool for existing products is a Vendix Pro feature.

Product Identifiers & Cost

  • Eight independent fields: MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP/Customs Tariff Number, Manufacturer, Supplier, Cost, Shipping Cost and Other Costs.
  • Every field is configured on its own — admin field, variation support, list column, Quick Edit support, frontend display and Schema.org output are all separate toggles.
  • A live, unsaved profit-margin estimate appears on the product edit screen as you type, using an estimated tax rate for the product’s tax class. The admin product list shows the exact, tax-aware margin, computed with WooCommerce’s own pricing logic from the real selling price.
  • Structured data output is automatically skipped when a dedicated SEO plugin (Yoast, RankMath, SEOPress, AIOSEO, The SEO Framework) is active, avoiding duplicate Product schema.

short_description: 33 Elementor widgets, company data, a design system, 3,800 icons, SEO, a header and footer builder, WooCommerce tools and review-first AI media.
description:
ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor is the free website foundation of the Vendix ecosystem. It combines essential Elementor widgets with centralized business information and practical tools for search visibility, structured data, icons and media management.

One focused workspace replaces a separate plugin for every small need.

✨ Everything included in Free

  • Guided Setup with one-click undo.
  • 33 Elementor widgets, with news widgets and the ARN Form.
  • Company Information with shortcodes and Dynamic Tags.
  • Design System: brand colors and body and heading fonts for ARN widgets or the whole site; Google fonts are downloaded once and served from the site.
  • ARN Smart Icon Manager with 3,800 font-free icons.
  • SEO & Visibility Engine, Header & Footer Builder and review-first AI Media Intelligence.
  • Smart Features and WooCommerce Tools.
  • Responsive, RTL/LTR and accessibility-aware output; optional systems load only when required.
  • No license key and no private updater: updates come through the WordPress repository.

🧭 Guided Setup

ARN Utilities → Setup opens once after the first activation (the Vendix theme’s welcome page leads to it too) and sets up a site in about five minutes.

  • Pick Business, News & Magazine or Online Store to turn on the features that kind of site needs.
  • Choose one of six palettes and four font pairs (or keep your colors), enter company details once, and optionally add sample pages, a Main menu and a simple header and footer. WooCommerce is installed and activated only when you click.
  • Undo setup restores your earlier settings and moves the pages and layouts it made to the Trash; posts, products, orders, existing pages and menus are never touched.

🧩 33 Elementor widgets

Widgets sit in the ARN Smart Site Utilities Elementor category and start with sample text and drawings, so a page looks finished before you edit it.

  • Headings and text: Advanced Heading, Icon Heading, List Block, Smart Text Editor.
  • Hero and calls to action: Hero Slider, Button, CTA, Counter, Feature Block, Process / Timeline, Pricing Table.
  • People and trust: Testimonials, Team Members, Logo Carousel, Rating Badge.
  • Company and contact: Company Information, Contact Cards, Get in Touch, Business Hours, ARN Form.
  • Site parts: Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools, Site Logo, Breadcrumbs, Announcement Bar.
  • Content and media: Post / Content Grid, FAQ, Responsive Image, Release Notes.
  • News widgets (Smart Features → News Widgets, off by default): Section Header, News Blocks, News Ticker.

Site Utilities runs on other themes too; it is developed and tested with the Vendix theme, where it fits best. The FAQ describes each widget.

🧱 Header & Footer Builder

Build site headers and footers under ARN Utilities → Header & Footer without a page builder template.

  • Rows and columns with logo, menu, mobile menu, search, button, text, contact, social, language, account, cart, wishlist, copyright, image, HTML, spacer and divider elements.
  • Display rules (whole site, front page, search, 404, single content or archives) with exclusions; sticky and transparent headers (kept below a sticky ARN Announcement Bar), a mobile panel and live preview.
  • A page, post or product can pick its own header and footer (by the rules, none or a published layout) on its edit screen or in Elementor’s page settings.
  • Works with classic and block themes, Elementor Full Width and Canvas templates, and the Vendix theme’s header and footer places.
  • Keyboard and screen reader friendly: the mobile panel and search layer keep the focus inside, and Escape closes a sub-menu.

🏢 Company Information, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags

Enter website, company, contact, legal and social data once under ARN Utilities → Company Data and reuse it in Site Utilities widgets, in any content through shortcodes, and in native Elementor widgets through Dynamic Tags.

Policies, agreements, contact pages and footers repeat the same details; with shortcodes, an address, phone number or legal detail is updated in one field instead of on dozens of pages:

[arnsmesu_company_legal_name], registered under [arnsmesu_company_trade_registry], operates from [arnsmesu_company_address]. Contact: [arnsmesu_company_phone].

The FAQ lists every field, shortcode and Dynamic Tag.

🎨 ARN Smart Icon Manager

  • 3,800 unique, font-free SVG-mask icons in two sets, Default Icons (1,181) and Interface Essentials (2,994), that take the Elementor color and scale cleanly at any size.
  • Category and icon search, a personal My Icons selection and whole categories; large styles load by pack, not the whole library on every page.
  • Disabling a category never breaks icons already saved in Elementor content. Elementor’s own and Font Awesome libraries remain available.

📈 SEO & Visibility Engine

Off until an administrator enables it, the Visibility Engine works as a complete visibility layer, or only as an analyzer when another supported SEO plugin controls public metadata.

  • SEO title, meta description, canonical URL, robots, Open Graph and X cards, with a live social sharing preview.
  • Analysis of the rendered content (Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, shortcodes) with a page language check, a readiness score and recommendations.
  • Connected JSON-LD Schema and a controlled XML sitemap.

These tools improve content structure and machine understanding; they do not promise rankings or AI citations.

🤖 AI Media Intelligence

AI Media is optional, disabled by default and preview-first, so an administrator stays in control.

  • Filename, title, slug and alt-text suggestions, previewed before applying, one by one or in batches.
  • Filename changes keep WordPress metadata and content references in sync; every change is recorded and can be restored.
  • Optional alt text for newly uploaded images.

AI runs through Settings → ARN Free AI, shared by ARN Free plugins: WordPress AI (Settings → Connectors on WordPress 7.0+, no API key stored), or your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot AI), xAI Grok, Mistral or an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint, with the model you choose, prices, usage and monthly limits. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.

If ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI, AI Media leaves suggestions and automatic alt text to it and links to it.

🧰 Smart Features

Each is switched on or off under ARN Utilities → Smart Features:

  • Admin Notes on the dashboard, personal or shared.
  • Draft Preview Links that expire after 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days and can be revoked.
  • Search & Replace for the database with preview, undo of the last 5 runs, old domain scan and cache purge.
  • Disable Comments site-wide, without ever deleting existing comments.
  • Site Banner, News Widgets and the Quick Menu of admin shortcuts to filtered lists.
  • Push Notifications for new posts with a subscribe box, sent from your own site (Web Push, no third-party service).

🛒 WooCommerce Tools

With WooCommerce active; each tool is off by default.

  • Store Type: Physical, Virtual, Digital or Mixed; the product editor adjusts, existing products are never changed automatically.
  • Product Identifiers & Cost: MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP, Manufacturer, Supplier and three cost fields, with live, tax-aware profit margins; costs are never shown to customers.
  • Quantity Discounts: tiers such as “5 or more: 10% off”, applied in the classic and block cart.
  • Order Limits: minimum and maximum quantities and amounts per product, category or cart.
  • Customer Order Changes: before shipping, logged-in customers change the delivery address or cancel from My Account, within your rules.
  • Product Questions: customers ask on the product page; answers show in a “Questions” tab and e-mail the asker.
  • Shipping on the Product Page: shipping methods and costs for the customer’s address, under “Add to cart”.
  • Product Interest: 30-day views and adds to cart per product, without cookies or personal data.
  • Pricing Zones: prices per group of countries by a percentage with rounding; the zone comes from the visitor’s choice ([arnsmesu_zone_selector]), their address or WooCommerce geolocation, and payment stays in the store currency.

⚙️ Settings and data lifecycle

  • Optional modules stay inactive until enabled; deactivation never deletes settings, content or company information.
  • Data is removed only with the uninstall option on and the plugin deleted; Vendix Pro data and Elementor templates stay. Multisite-aware.

⭐ Upgrade to ARN Smart Vendix Pro

ARN Smart Vendix, the professional Elementor framework for larger websites, includes all of Free and adds:

  • More widgets (hero designs, sliders, carousels, tabs, tickers, countdowns, pricing and comparison tables, modals, hotspots, before/after images) and more layouts for the Free widgets.
  • The full newspaper set, the full Design System with the Elementor Kit, and advanced and custom setup levels.
  • Form Guard, per content-type Disable Comments, a Store Type scan-and-convert tool and other site tools.
  • Dynamic Content (your own content types and fields) with listings, showcase cards and a demo gallery; quote and newsletter forms; push for breaking news, topics, store updates and campaigns, also via OneSignal or Firebase.
  • Store modules such as discount rules, quotes, delivery slots, returns and exchanges and a profit report.
  • AEO / GEO / AIO analysis, E-E-A-T evidence checks and the Site Report.
  • License management, private Pro updates and priority support.

Site Utilities stays independently installable and usable without a Vendix Pro license.

🔗 Other ARN Smart Products

Focused ARN Smart products, usable alone or together:

  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer / ARN Smart WebPix — local image optimization in Free; advanced discovery, coverage, queues, delivery, and diagnostics in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Content Toolkit / ARN Smart Clonex — controlled draft preparation in Free; structured duplication, datasets, bulk production, and builder-aware workflows in Pro.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager / ARN Smart Linkix — short links, redirects, QR codes, and local analytics in Free; custom permalinks, Smart App Links, branded QR, analytics, and maintenance in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Visitor Intent / ARN Smart Visioix — visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics, and contact actions in Free; connected visitor and website intelligence in Pro.

Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External services

AI Media (ARN Free AI). The plugin contacts no ARN server. AI stays off until an administrator chooses a provider and enters their own API key (stored encrypted in the database) under Settings > ARN Free AI; requests then go to that provider only.

Requests are sent only while Media Intelligence is enabled: when an administrator clicks AI Preview or Generate Selected Previews, or when automatic alt text (off by default) runs for a new upload. Sent data: the image (a copy of at most 4 MB, preferably a smaller WordPress size; SVG files are not sent) and its context: site name and tagline, file name and type, title, slug, current alt text, caption, a short description, the parent post title, the titles and short excerpts of up to three posts that use the file, and the site language. “Test connection” (a fixed test prompt, no site content) and “Load models” (the provider’s model list) also contact the chosen provider when clicked. Nothing is sent while AI is not set up or while ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: the address the administrator enters, under that service’s own terms.

With WordPress AI, requests go through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

ARN Free AI keeps its settings in the arn_free_ai_settings option and daily usage totals (no prompts, answers or keys) in the {prefix}arn_free_ai_usage table.

Design System Google fonts. Only when an administrator picks a Google font for body or headings under ARN Utilities > Design System and saves, the server downloads it once: the stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and its WOFF2 files from fonts.gstatic.com (Latin, Latin Extended and Arabic, the Design System’s weights). Only the font family and weights are sent, no visitor or site data. The files are served from wp-content/uploads/arnsmesu-fonts, so visitors’ browsers never connect to Google. The font list comes from Elementor.

  • Google Fonts: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy

Search & Replace. Only when an administrator uses it: “Find old addresses” sends one HTTP HEAD request for a sample file to each of at most 5 earlier site addresses found in the database, to see whether they still answer (no site data is sent); after a run or an undo, the plugin requests the site’s own home page once to detect a server or CDN page cache.

Guided Setup. Only when an administrator clicks “Install & activate” on the Plugins step of an online-store setup: WordPress’s own plugin installer downloads WooCommerce from WordPress.org, as under Plugins → Add Plugin. No other setup step uses an external service.

  • WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

Web push notifications. With Push Notifications on (Smart Features), your site itself sends each notification, encrypted, to the push service of the subscribed visitor’s browser, with no account or third-party notification service. The browser, not this plugin, picks the service:

  • Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet, Brave): https://fcm.googleapis.com — Terms: https://firebase.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Mozilla Push Service (Firefox): https://updates.push.services.mozilla.com — Terms: https://www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/services/ — Privacy: https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/firefox/
  • Apple Push Notification service (Safari, iPhone and iPad): https://web.push.apple.com — Privacy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/
  • Microsoft Windows Push Notification Services (older Edge): https://*.notify.windows.com — Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

Requests are sent only when a notification goes out (a post published with “Send to subscribers when published” ticked, or a test), to the address the visitor’s browser gave when subscribing. Each carries the notification (title, text, link, image address) encrypted for that browser only, a time to live, and a signed header with your site’s public key and your site address or contact e-mail. The plugin sends no visitor IP address or other visitor personal data. Nothing is sent while the feature is off.

The Header & Footer Builder, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links, Social Sharing Preview, ARN Form and news reads and corrections use no external service.
